purpose: Hold one exact source and hand an explicit immutable snapshot to unequal native tools; keep source-bound evidence and return only evidence matching the currently held source.

axes.input: validated decision model/receipt JSON or legacy FORM/FUNCTION/FORTITUDE pipe rows

source.identity: first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 source text
source.mutation: Explicit USE creates a new local source snapshot; UNDO restores exact prior bytes.
source.undo: Restore the prior held source exactly; undo is not a semantic inverse of the transformation

bench.ownership: Native Bench owns editable criteria, min/max limits, intervals, options, uncertainty, Pareto comparison, priority, local state and decision RETURN. Omnitools owns source transport only.
bench.handoff: same-origin postMessage from explicit LOAD; requestId binds a frozen source snapshot
bench.unknown_law: Unknown and threshold-crossing evidence remain explicit UNCERTAIN alternatives and are excluded from guaranteed feasible ranking without being deleted.
bench.generic_model: 1–8 independent measured criteria; 0–40 options; finite exact/ranged values, explicit null unknowns, min/max limits and optional main priority
bench.legacy_adapter: Native Bench alone parses NAME | FORM | FUNCTION | FORTITUDE | note into max-preference criteria with declared score units, no implicit thresholds and no priority; no independent Omni evaluator runs.

bridge.admission: event.origin must equal location.origin and event.source must equal the native Bench iframe window
bridge.invalid_input: changed(valid:false) clears cached carrier decision evidence
bridge.standalone_return: null/unknown requestId never binds native decision to held source
bridge.source_change: Previous source evidence remains tagged in trace but is excluded from current carrier bench/preview fields.
bridge.reentry: Native Bench owns exact persisted decision reentry; session source transport does not create another decision store.

contains: matching-source native decision receipt when explicitly recorded

laws: UNEQUAL TOOLS MAY SHARE A CARRIER WITHOUT SHARING SEMANTICS
stop: Do not add another Omnitools evaluator, child, or state authority. Change an existing native tool only for a reproduced operation failure.

operation_transfer.input: Full native transform result bound to the still-held exact source
operation_transfer.effect: New local source snapshot, no external effect
operation_transfer.boundary: Clipped previews and stale results are not transferable output
operation_transfer.failure: Empty, unavailable or stale output leaves source unchanged and records no successful effect

research.scope: Three primary mechanism donors only; historical broad survey retained in Git history
research.status: SCOUT/PARK; source documentation verified, host replica and transfer evidence pending
research.imports: No external code, artwork, dependency or appearance imported

donors.mechanism: distinct input/output, ordered transforms, visible intermediate state
donors.host_delta: explicit full-output promotion with exact source undo

donors.mechanism: atomic cancelled turns, undo and bounded camera views
donors.host_delta: failed moves preserve state; primary work fits one viewport stage

donors.mechanism: sparse monochrome icons with retained text identity and touch clearance
donors.host_delta: stable monochrome operation glyph plus short label and accessible name; touch-density trade-off remains explicit

acceptance: Full native output becomes the exact new source; UNDO restores exact prior label/text including Unicode and whitespace.
Empty, unavailable or stale outputs fail without source mutation or success receipts.
Source changes exclude stale results and retain source-tagged trace continuity.
Primary work fits one viewport; explicit paging retains depth. Short labeled actions retain keyboard names; touch sizing remains a separate usability measure.
Native generic Bench remains the only decision evaluator and state owner; unknowns and physical measurements are never fabricated.

handoff.delta: Generalized native decision bench, strict loss-aware conversion, full-result source promotion, exact source undo, bounded native stages and source-bound RETURN.
handoff.next: Use one actual input; report the operation, friction and exact RETURN. Device-local results are not physical or adoption proof.
